candidates.title: Documental "Raíces nuestras". Sevilla (España).
candidates.description: Documental creado por los grupos de pregraduado y graduado del Centro de Educación de Adultos José Sánchez Rosa (Sevilla, España), cursos 92/93 y 93/94.  Documental que narra a grandes rasgos parte de la historia del distrito Macarena, comenzando por el siglo II a.C., pasando por los movimientos socio-culturales de la gente que lo ha ido poblando y que ha logrado la configuración actual de nuestras barriadas. La parte final del documental se centra en el Hospital de las Cinco Llagas, la ampliación del perímetro de huertas del siglo XVI, la Finca de la Albarrana y sus los sistemas hidráulicos y mecánicos de dicha finca y el Cortijo Miraflores, ejemplo de arquitectura rural tradicional andaluza.

candidates.title: Battle For Best Student | Jujutsu Kaisen Fan Animation
candidates.description:
Support 6 Bird Studio: https:/patreon.com/6BirdStudio
Contact: https://www.6bird.studio/
Special thanks to the talents of this film:
@AKMotions @CakeStation @Sy_xxwhiterose @Sheevo @TheJumpButton 

This was a 6BirdStudio group project initially conceived at AnimeExpo. It took around 7 months to complete. The idea was originally to base this on Miwa and Mechamaru's relationship/dynamic. This was a clearly one sided match up, everyone who watches the show should know Yuji and Maki are superior in terms of skill. however during their spar Mechamaru's brain and cursed technique comes in handy. His plan was initially to separate Maki and eliminate her with a huge Ultimate cannon blast so he could help Miwa fight Yuji, however when Maki comes back into the picture the fight started to turn back into Yuji and Maki's favor. So Mechamaru had one more trick up his sleeve. Separate Yuji by making him deal with his puppets long enough for him and Miwa to deal with Maki. When Mahito enters. He traps everyone in a veil. However Mechamaru being the genius he is planned for everything and prior gave Gojo a device that would sound an alarm if a veil was raised (That part would never have been understood unless you read this). So The veil shatters and Inumaki and Gojo enter the fight. Clearly Mahito was feeling silly because he decided to actually fight Gojo. Which led to his heart being deleted. And yes... we know Mahito wouldn't die from his heart being removed.

Animated using Blender
Thank you for watching 6 Bird Studio!  Please enjoy our work and go make something yourself!

candidates.title: La Puerta De La Libertad (1989) TV/DVD Rip Español
candidates.description: Título: La puerta de la libertad Productor: TVE Dirección: Informe Semanal Género: Documental. Drama. Política Nacionalidad: Española El domingo 9 de noviembre quizás para algunos de vosotros fue un día festivo más, sin embargo para otros seguro que fue un día muy especial, y es que este pasado domingo se cumplían 25 años de la caída del muro de Berlín. Siempre he pensado en el como el «Muro de la Vergüenza«, sin duda es uno de los episodios más abominables que ha perpetrado el hombre en un mundo a veces tan ruin y asqueroso, en el que me ha tocado vivir. No podemos ni debemos olvidar a los 138 seres humanos (datos oficiales), que murieron mientras intentaban atravesar el muro a través de túneles e intentos suicidas. Tentativas desesperadas, con el único anhelo de reunirse con un padre, una madre, un hermano o un hijo, no hay muro en la tierra que pueda separarme de mi hija, de su olor, sus caricias, su sonrisa, no lo hay. El 9 de noviembre de 2014, para conmemorar los 25 años de la caída del muro de Berlín (muro de la vergüenza), el canal 24 horas de RTVE rescató el documental «Puerta a la Libertad» emitido el 11 noviembre de 1989 por TVE. Un reportaje de Informe Semanal, inmediatamente posterior a la caída del muero de Berlín. Éste vídeo procede de una grabación hecha durante su emisión en un DVD-Video.

candidates.title: 1930 FIFA World Cup
candidates.description: 1930 FIFA World Cup by FIFA Movie created during 2004, on FIFA's 100th annivesary. Published at YouTube by Guillermo Gaitan on June 13rd, 2012. _________________________________________________________________________ A compilation of videos done by various YouTube and other content creators across all time or spaces. There isn't a structured nor defined objective with archiving this apart from the sake of it. Perphaps they might contain useful to you, perphaps not yet, nonetheless, they contain with it the memory and wisdom of people that once stood and breathed just like you. _________________________________________________________________________ A video documentary on the first ever official FIFA Football World Cup. About the 1930 World Cup ( from Wikipedia  & The Daily Star ): Summary The 1930 FIFA World Cup was the inaugural FIFA World Cup, the world championship for men's national association football teams. It took place in Uruguay from 13 to 30 July 1930. FIFA, football's international governing body, selected Uruguay as host nation, as the country would be celebrating the centenary of its first constitution and the Uruguay national football team had successfully retained their football title at the 1928 Summer Olympics. All matches were played in the Uruguayan capital, Montevideo, the majority at the Estadio Centenario, which was built for the tournament. Thirteen teams (seven from South America, four from Europe and two from North America) entered the tournament. Only a few European teams chose to participate because of the difficulty of travelling to South America. The teams were divided into four groups, with the winner of each group progressing to the semi-finals. The first two World Cup matches took place simultaneously and were won by France and the United States, who defeated Mexico 4–1 and Belgium 3–0, respectively. Lucien Laurent of France scored the first goal in World Cup history, while that day United States goalkeeper Jimmy Douglas posted the first "clean sheet" in the tournament. Argentina, Uruguay, the United States and Yugoslavia each won their respective groups to qualify for the semi-finals. In the final, hosts and pre-tournament favourites Uruguay defeated Argentina 4–2 in front of a crowd of 68,346 people to become the first nation to win the World Cup. Context FIFA, the governing body of world football, had been discussing the creation of a competition for national teams for several years prior to 1930. The organisation had managed the football segment of the Summer Olympics on behalf of the International Olympic Committee since the early 20th century and the success of the competition at the 1924 and 1928 Olympic Games led to the formation of the FIFA World Cup. At the 17th FIFA congress, held in Amsterdam in May 1928, the competition was proposed by president Jules Rimet and accepted by the organisation's board, with vice-president Henri Delaunay proclaiming "international football can no longer be held within the confines of the Olympics". The first World Cup was the only one without qualification. Every country affiliated with FIFA was invited to compete and given a deadline of 28 February 1930 to accept. The competition was originally planned as a 16-team knockout tournament with a potential second division if enough teams entered; however, the number of teams failed to reach 16, so there were no qualifications. Plenty of interest was shown by nations in the Americas; Argentina, Brazil, Bolivia, Chile, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru and the United States all entered. A total of seven South American teams participated, more than in any subsequent World Cup Finals. However, because of the long, costly trip by ship across the Atlantic Ocean and the length of absence required for players, very few European teams were inclined to take part as the effects of the Great Depression set in across the continent. Some refused to countenance travel to South America in any circumstances, and no European entries were received before the February deadline.  In an attempt to gain some European participation, the Uruguayan Football Association sent a letter of invitation to The Football Association, even though the British Home Nations (England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales) had resigned from FIFA at the time. This was rejected by the FA Committee on 18 November 1929. Out of the two Asian countries affiliated to FIFA at the time, Japan and Siam (modern-day Thailand), neither elected to enter the competition, while Egypt, the lone African team to enter, was delayed by a storm in the Mediterranean, and the ship intended to take them to Uruguay departed without them. Two months before the start of the tournament, no team from Europe had officially entered. FIFA president Rimet and Uruguayan diplomat Enrique Buero intervened and four European teams eventually made the trip by sea: Belgium, France, Romania and Yugoslavia. The Romanians, managed by Constantin Rădulescu and coached by their captain Rudolf Wetzer and Octav Luchide, entered the competition following the intervention of the newly crowned King Carol II. He selected the squad personally and negotiated with employers to ensure that the players would still have jobs upon their return. The French entered at the personal intervention of Rimet, but neither France's star defender Manuel Anatol nor the team's regular coach Gaston Barreau could be persuaded to make the trip. The Belgians participated at the instigation of German-Belgian FIFA vice-president Rodolphe Seeldrayers. The Romanians boarded the SS Conte Verde at Genoa, Italy; the French and Yugoslavs were picked up at Villefranche-sur-Mer, France, on 21 June 1930; and the Belgians embarked at Barcelona, Spain. The Conte Verde carried Rimet, the trophy and the three designated European referees: Belgians John Langenus and Henri Christophe, along with Thomas Balvay, a Parisian who may have been English. The Brazilian team were picked up when the boat docked in Rio de Janeiro on 29 June before arriving in Uruguay on 4 July. The official ball used for the tournament was the T-Model. Venues All matches took place in Montevideo. Three stadiums were used: Estadio Centenario, Estadio Pocitos and Estadio Gran Parque Central. The Estadio Centenario was built both for the tournament and as a celebration of the centenary of Uruguayan independence. Designed by Juan Scasso, it was the primary stadium for the tournament, referred to by Rimet as a "temple of football". With a capacity of 90,000, it was the largest football stadium outside the British Isles. The stadium hosted 10 of the 18 matches, including both semi-finals and the final. However, a rushed construction schedule and delays caused by the rainy season meant the Centenario was not ready for use until five days into the tournament. Early matches were played at smaller stadiums usually used by Montevideo football clubs Nacional and Peñarol, the 20,000 capacity Parque Central and the Pocitos. Tournament and Summary Group 1 The first group was the only one to contain four teams: Argentina, Chile, France and Mexico. Two days after France's victory over Mexico, they faced group favourites Argentina. Injuries hindered France; goalkeeper Alex Thépot had to leave the field after 20 minutes and Laurent, after a fierce tackle by Luis Monti, spent most of the match limping. However, they held out for most of the match, only succumbing to an 81st-minute goal scored from a Monti free kick. The game featured an officiating controversy when referee Almeida Rêgo erroneously blew the final whistle six minutes early, with Frenchman Marcel Langiller clear on goal; play resumed only after protests from the French players. Although France had played twice in 48 hours, Chile had yet to play their first match. They faced Mexico the following day, gaining a comfortable 3–0 win. France's final match, against Chile, featured the first penalty kick of the World Cup. The first goalkeeper to save a penalty was Alex Thépot of France on 19 July 1930, saving from Chile's Carlos Vidal in the 30th minute of the match. In Argentina's second match, against Mexico, three penalty kicks were awarded. During the same match on 19 July 1930 Mexico's Oscar Bonfiglio Martínez saved another penalty at the 23rd minute of the match against Argentina's Fernando Paternoster. Guillermo Stábile scored a hat-trick in his international debut as Argentina won 6–3, despite the absence of their captain Manuel Ferreira, who had returned to Buenos Aires to take a law exam. Qualification was decided by the group's final match, contested by Argentina and Chile, who had beaten France and Mexico, respectively. The game was marred by a brawl sparked by a foul on Arturo Torres by Monti. Argentina won 3–1 against their neighbours and advanced to the semi-finals. Evaristo  51' Group 2 The second group contained Brazil, Bolivia and Yugoslavia. Brazil, the group seeds, were expected to progress, but in the group's opening match, unexpectedly lost 2–1 to Yugoslavia. Going into the tournament Bolivia had never previously won an international match. For their opener they paid tribute to the hosts by wearing shirts each emblazoned with a single letter, spelling "Viva Uruguay" as the team lined up. Both of Bolivia's matches followed a similar pattern, a promising start gradually transforming into heavy defeat. Against Yugoslavia, they held out for an hour before conceding, but were four goals down by the final whistle. Misfortune played its part; several Bolivian goals were disallowed. Against Brazil, when both teams had only pride to play for, the score was 1–0 to Brazil at half-time. Brazil added three more in the second half, two of them scored by the multi-sportsman Preguinho. Yugoslavia qualified for the semi-finals. Matches 14 July 1930 12:45 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Yugoslavia 2–1 Brazil Estadio Parque Central, Montevideo — Attendance: 24,059 — Referee: Aníbal Tejada (Uruguay) Yugoslavia —  Tirnanić  21' Yugoslavia —  Bek  30' Brazil —  Preguinho  62' 17 July 1930 12:45 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Yugoslavia 4–0 Bolivia Estadio Parque Central, Montevideo — Attendance: 18,306 — Referee: Francisco Mateucci (Uruguay) Yugoslavia  —  Bek  60' Yugoslavia  —  Bek  67' Yugoslavia  —  Marjanović  65' Yugoslavia  —  Vujadinović  85' 20 July 1930 13:00 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Brazil 4–0 Bolivia Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 25,466 — Referee: Thomas Balvay (France) Brazil — Moderato  37' Brazil — Preguinho  57' Brazil —  Moderato  73' Brazil —  Preguinho  83' Group 3 Hosts Uruguay were in a group with Peru and Romania. The opening match in this group saw the first player expulsion in the competition, when Plácido Galindo of Peru was dismissed against Romania. The Romanians made their man advantage pay; their 3–1 win included two late goals. This match had the smallest crowd of any in World Cup history. The official attendance was 2,459, but the actual figure is generally accepted to be around 300. Because of construction delays at Estadio Centenario, Uruguay's first match was not played until five days into the tournament. The first to be held at the Centenario, it was preceded by a ceremony in honour of the Uruguayan centenary celebrations. The Uruguayan team spent the four weeks preceding the match in a training camp, at which strict discipline was exercised. Goalkeeper Andrés Mazali was dropped from the squad for breaking a curfew to visit his wife. One hundred years to the day of the creation of Uruguay's first constitution, the hosts won a tight match against Peru 1–0. Spectators praised Peru's defense and this turned out to be the only match in the tournament in which Uruguay scored only one goal. The result was viewed as a poor performance by the Uruguayan press, but lauded in Peru. Uruguay subsequently defeated Romania with ease, scoring four first half goals to win 4–0. Matches 14 July 1930 14:50 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Romania 3–1 Peru Estadio Pocitos, Montevideo — Attendance: 2,549 — Referee: Alberto Warnken (Chile) Romania —  Deșu  1' Peru —  De Souza  75' Romania — Stanciu  79' Romania — Kovács  89' 18 July 1930 14:30 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Uruguay 1–0 Peru Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 57,735 — Referee: John Langenus (Belgium) Uruguay — Castro  65' 21 July 1930 14:50 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Uruguay 4–0 Romania Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 70,022 — Referee: Almeida Rêgo (Brazil) Uruguay — Dorado  7' Uruguay — Scarone  26' Uruguay — Anselmo  31' Uruguay — Cea  35' Group 4 The fourth group contained Belgium, Paraguay and the United States. The American team, which contained a significant number of new caps, were reputedly nicknamed "the shot-putters" by an unnamed source in the French contingent. They beat their first opponents, Belgium, 3–0. The ease of the victory was unexpected; Uruguayan newspaper Imparcial wrote that "the large score of the American victory has really surprised the experts". Belgian reports bemoaned the state of the pitch and refereeing decisions, claiming that the second goal was offside. The group's second match, played in windy conditions, witnessed the first tournament hat-trick, scored by Bert Patenaude of the United States against Paraguay. Until 10 November 2006, the first hat-trick that FIFA acknowledged had been scored by Guillermo Stábile of Argentina, two days after Patenaude; however, in 2006 FIFA announced that Patenaude's claim to being the first hat-trick scorer was valid, as a goal previously assigned to teammate Tom Florie was reattributed to Patenaude. With the United States having secured qualification, the final match in the group was a dead rubber. Paraguay beat Belgium by a 1–0 margin. Matches 13 July 1930 15:00 UYT (UTC–03:30) — United States 3–0 Belgium Estadio Parque Central, Montevideo — Attendance: 18,346 — Referee: José Macías (Argentina) United States — McGhee  23' United States — Florie  45' United States — Patenaude  69' 17 July 1930 14:45 UYT (UTC–03:30) — United States 3–0 Paraguay Estadio Parque Central, Montevideo — Attendance: 18,306 — Referee: José Macías (Argentina) United States — Patenaude  10' United States — Patenaude  15' United States — Patenaude  50' 26 July 1930 15:00 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Paraguay 1–0 Belgium Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 12,000 — Referee: Ricardo Vallarino (Uruguay) Paraguay — Vargas Peña   40' Semi-finals The four group winners, Argentina, Yugoslavia, Uruguay and the United States, moved to the semi-finals. The two semi-final matches saw identical scores. The first semi-final was played between the United States and Argentina on a rain-drenched pitch. The United States team, which featured six British-born players, lost midfielder Raphael Tracy after 10 minutes to a broken leg as the match became violent. A Monti goal halfway through the first half gave Argentina a 1–0 half-time lead. In the second half, the strength of the United States team was overwhelmed by the pace of the Argentinian attacks, the match finishing 6–1 to Argentina. In the second semi-final there were shades of the 1924 Summer Olympics match between Yugoslavia and Uruguay. Here, though, Yugoslavia took a surprise lead through Vujadinović. Uruguay then took a 2–1 lead. Then shortly before half-time Yugoslavia had a goal disallowed by a controversial offside decision. The hosts scored three more in the second half to win 6–1, Pedro Cea completing a hat-trick. Matches 26 July 1930 14:45 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Argentina 6–1 United States Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 72,886 — Referee: John Langenus (Belgium) Argentina — Monti  20' Argentina — Scopelli  56' Argentina — Stábile   69' Argentina — Peucelle  80' Argentina — Peucelle  85' Argentina — Stábile  87' United States — Brown  89' 27 July 1930 14:45 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Argentina 6–1 United States Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 79,867 — Referee: Gilberto de Almeida Rêgo (Brazil) Yugoslavia — Vujadinović  4' Uruguay — Cea  18' Uruguay — Anselmo  20' Uruguay — Anselmo  31' Uruguay — Iriarte  61' Uruguay — Cea  67' Uruguay — Cea   72' "Third Place Playoff" The now-traditional third place play-off was not established until 1934, so the format of the 1930 World Cup is unique in not distinguishing between the third and fourth placed teams. Occasional sources, notably a FIFA Bulletin from 1984, incorrectly imply that a third-place match occurred and was won 3–1 by Yugoslavia. Accounts differ as to whether a third-place match was originally scheduled. According to a 2009 book by Hyder Jawad, Yugoslavia refused to play a third-place match because they were upset with the refereeing in their semi-final against Uruguay. At the end of the championship, the captains of the United States team (Tom Florie) and Yugoslavia (Milutin Ivković) both received bronze medals. Yet a FIFA technical committee report on the 1986 World Cup included full retrospective rankings of all teams at all previous World Cup finals; this report ranked the United States third and Yugoslavia fourth, due to a better goal difference on otherwise identical records, a practice since continued by FIFA. In 2010, the son of Kosta Hadži, the chief of Yugoslav delegation at the 1930 World Cup and the vice-president of the Football Association of Yugoslavia at the time, claimed that Yugoslavia, as a team, has been awarded one bronze medal, which has been kept by Hadži himself and his family for the following 80 years. According to this source, Yugoslavia was placed third because of the semi-finals loss to the eventual champions, Uruguay. The official recording however shows the United States team claiming third place. Final The final match of the 1930 FIFA World Cup, the inaugural edition of FIFA's competition for national football teams, was played at the Estadio Centenario in Montevideo, Uruguay, on 30 July 1930, and was contested by Uruguay and Argentina. The resounding wins for Uruguay and Argentina in the semi-finals meant the final was a repeat of the matchup in the 1928 Olympic final, which Uruguay had won 2–1 after a replay. The final was played at the Estadio Centenario on 30 July. Feelings ran high around the La Plata Basin as the Argentine supporters crossed the river with the war cry "Victoria o muerte"   ("victory or death") , dispelling any uncertainty as to whether the tournament had captured the imagination of the public. The ten boats earmarked to carry Argentine fans from Buenos Aires to Montevideo proved inadequate, and any number of assorted craft attempted the crossing. An estimated 10–15,000 Argentinians made the trip, but the port at Montevideo was so overwhelmed that many did not even make landfall before kick-off, let alone reach the stadium. At the stadium, supporters were searched for weapons —authorities and security personnel are estimated to have confiscated up to 1,600 revolvers. The gates were opened at eight o'clock, six hours before kick-off, and by noon the ground was full, the official attendance 93,000.  A disagreement overshadowed the build-up to the match as the teams failed to agree on who should provide the match ball, forcing FIFA to intervene and decree that the Argentine team would provide the ball for the first half and the Uruguayans would provide their own for the second. Uruguay made one change from their semi-final line-up. Castro replaced Anselmo, who missed out due to illness. Monti played for Argentina despite receiving death threats on the eve of the match. The referee was Belgian John Langenus, who only agreed to officiate a few hours before the game, having sought assurances for his safety. One of his requests was for a boat to be ready at the harbour within one hour of the final whistle, in case he needed to make a quick escape. Before the final, the Argentine players were not in the best mental state. Roberto Cherro withdrew from the match, Adolfo Zumelzu was injured, and even Francisco Varallo, known as “The Little Cannon,” was reluctant to play due to a knee injury. The most sensational fact was that Luis Monti and his family had received death threats from unknown sources. Rumors suggested that the Italian mafia was behind it. Their plan was for Monti to lose while wearing Argentina’s jersey and, under pressure, join Italian club Juventus while acquiring Italian citizenship. Monti later admitted, “I was very afraid during that match because they threatened to kill me and my mother.” The hosts scored the opening goal through Pablo Dorado, a low shot from a position on the right. Argentina, displaying superior passing ability, responded strongly. Within eight minutes they were back on level terms; Carlos Peucelle received a Ferreira through-ball, beat his marker and equalised. Shortly before half-time leading tournament goalscorer Guillermo Stábile gave Argentina a 2–1 lead. Uruguay captain Nasazzi protested, maintaining that Stábile was offside, but to no avail. In the second half Uruguay gradually became ascendant. Shortly after Monti missed a chance to make the score 3–1, Uruguay attacked in numbers and Pedro Cea scored an equaliser. Ten minutes later, a goal by Santos Iriarte gave Uruguay the lead, and just before full-time Castro made it 4–2 to seal the win. Langenus ended the match a minute later and Uruguay added the title World Cup winners to their mantle of Olympic champions. Jules Rimet presented the World Cup Trophy, which was later named for him, to the head of the Uruguayan Football Association, Raúl Jude.  30 July 1930 12:45 UYT (UTC–03:30) — Uruguay 4–2 Argentina Estadio Centenario, Montevideo — Attendance: 90,000 — Referee: John Langenus ( Belgium) Uruguay — Dorado  12' Argentina — Peucelle  20' Argentina — Stábile   37' Uruguay — Cea   57' Uruguay — Iriarte  68' Uruguay — Castro   89' Aftermath The following day was declared a national holiday in Uruguay; in the Argentinian capital, Buenos Aires, an angered mob threw stones at the Uruguayan consulate before being dispersed by police who deployed tear gas and firearms into the air. "The demonstrators, who numbered several thousand, externalized their protest in front of the legation of the neighboring republic. The high state of tension provoked considerable disorders. Stones were thrown against the building, smashing several window panes. The intervention of the police from the respective precinct, who made use of tear gas and shots fired into the air, managed to disperse the rioters after persistent charges." — Crítica, 1930  The Argentine Football Association cut temporarily diplomatic relations with Uruguay's counterparts and did not play again up until the Campeonato Sudamericano in 1935. Francisco Varallo (who played as a forward for Argentina) was the last player of the final to die, on 30 August 2010. France, Yugoslavia and the United States all played friendlies in South America following the competition. Brazil played France on 1 August, Yugoslavia on 10 August and the United States on 17 August, while Argentina hosted Yugoslavia on 3 August. —————————————— Archived with the purposes of preservation.

candidates.title: Truth At Last: The Assassination Of Martin Luther King
candidates.description: James Corbett April 4, 2018 Corbett Report   Deathly Support Is it really worthwhile To take on to this fight When those who rule embody guile And always employ formidable might? Is the assertion of personal essence enough When the larger goal is gone? And the world is ever more cruel and rough With no-one able to atone. To think, it came to this. Was there no other way? Why a bullet and not a kiss, On or before that fateful day.   On April 4, 1967, Dr. Martin Luther King delivered a passionate speech at Riverside Church in New York staking out his opposition to the war in Vietnam.   KING : "A time comes when silence is betrayal." That time has come for us in relation to Vietnam. One year later to the day, he was assassinated.   Now, 50 years after that fateful day, the truth about the assassination of Dr. King can finally be told.   THE STAGE IS SET Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr., a pastor of Dexter Avenue Baptist Church, rose to national attention in 1955 by leading a boycott of the racial segregation of the public transit system in Montgomery, Alabama. Seeing the boycott through to a victory in the Supreme Court, where segregated buses were ruled unconstitutional, Dr. King, still just 28 years old, became in 1957 the leader of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference. Leading nonviolent protests in Birmingham in 1963, King was arrested and penned his "Letter From Birmingham Jail," outlining his strategy of nonviolent opposition to racism and cementing his place as the leader of the national civil rights movement.   But by 1967, that movement was fracturing. candidates.description: David Barsamian's Alternative Radio presents: Martin Luther King Jr.'s Speech - "Beyond Vietnam" given in New York, NY on Apr. 4th 1967. Every year, almost like clockwork around his birthday, Martin Luther King's "I Have a Dream" gets airplay. The charismatic orator is frozen on the steps of the Lincoln Memorial in August 1963. No doubt it was a great and historic presentation, profoundly moving and full of dazzling poetry and inspiring images. But he was to give another very significant speech that is often obscured. That was to come on April 4, 1967 in Riverside Church in New York. There King demonstrated his deep understanding of how the system works. He moved beyond a simple race analysis to include class and foreign policy issues. He forcefully denounced the war in Vietnam. He called the U.S. "the greatest purveyor of violence in the world" and he deplored the "giant triplets of racism, extreme materialism and militarism." Exactly one year later King was assassinated in Memphis where he had gone in solidarity with striking sanitation workers. Martin Luther King Jr. Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr, Nobel Peace Prize winner, is one of the 20th century's most enduring figures. He advocated and practiced civil disobedience and non-violence. He said, "Christ gave us the goals and Mahatma Gandhi the tactics." He rose to national prominence during the epic Montgomery bus boycott and then went on to spearhead a movement which ended juridical apartheid in the U.S. Produced by Alternative Radiohttp://AlternativeRadio.org Compiled by http://ZGraphix.org

candidates.title: Yolanda King, eldest child of civil rights legend Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., is dead. She was 51
candidates.description: Yolanda King, eldest child of civil rights legend Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., is dead. She was 51.eldest child of civil rights legend Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., is dead. She was 51.Â Yolanda Denise King, the oldest daughter of Rev. Martin Luther King Jr. and Coretta Scott King, passed away Tuesday night in Santa Monica, CA. She was 51 years old.ATLANTA (AP) - Yolanda King, eldest child of civil rights legend Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., is dead. She was 51. King, who pursued her father's dream of racial harmony through drama and motivational speaking, died late Tuesday in Santa Monica, Calif., said a spokesman for the King Center. The family did not know the cause of death, but relatives think it might have been a heart problem, the spokesman, Steve Klein, said. "She was an actress, author, producer, advocate for peace and non-violence, who was known and loved for her motivational and inspirational contributions to society," the King family said in a statement. Born Nov. 17, 1955, in Montgomery, Ala., Yolanda Denise King was just an infant when her home was bombed amid the turbulent civil rights era. She became an actress, ran a production company and appeared in numerous films, including "Ghosts of Mississippi," and as Rosa Parks in the 1978 miniseries "King." "Yolanda was lovely. She wore the mantle of princess, and she wore it with dignity and charm," said Rev. Joseph Lowery, one of her father's close aides in the civil rights movement. "She was a warm and gentle person and was thoroughly committed to the movement and found her own means of expressing that commitment through drama." Rev. Al Sharpton said he expressed his condolences to her brother, Martin Luther King III, on Wednesday. Sharpton said Yolanda King was a "torchbearer for her parents and a committed activist in her own right." "Yolanda never wavered from a commitment to non-violent social change and justice for all," he said. "She was the first daughter of the civil rights movement and never shamed her parents or her co-activists." Yolanda King founded and led Higher Ground Productions, billed as a "gateway for inner peace, unity and global transformation." On her company's website, she described her mission as encouraging personal growth and positive social change. She was also an author and a member of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference - which her father co-founded in 1957 - and the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People. The flag at The King Centre, where she was a board member, flew at half-mast on Wednesday. Yolanda King was the most visible and outspoken among Rev. Martin Luther King Jr.'s four children during this year's Martin Luther King Day in January, the first since the death of their mother, Coretta Scott King. At her father's Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta, she performed a series of solo skits that told stories including a girl's first ride on a desegregated bus and a college student's recollection of the 1963 desegregation of Birmingham, Ala. She also urged the audience to be a force for peace and love, and to use the King holiday each year to ask tough questions about their own beliefs about prejudice.Watch more TV videos on NATE PERKINS LIVE: IPTVÂ

candidates.title: ¿Por qué estudiar la Historia del Mundo Clásico? [El Club de los Emperadores, 2002]
candidates.description: ¿Qué valor tiene estudiar Historia y, en particular, Historia Antigua? ¿Qué debemos a los grandes hombres del mundo clásico? ¿Cómo se escribe la Historia? ¿Qué competencias se pueden adquirir a partir del estudio de la Antigüedad? son preguntas que, sin duda, se plantea cualquier estudiante universitario que tiene su primer contacto con los tiempos antiguos. Esta pieza del inicio de la película "El Club de los Emperadores" (Michael Hoffmann, 2002) ilustra muy bien cuál es el valor de la Antigüedad Clásica para la formación humanística. A través de la presentación de la materia "Civilizations of the Ancient Mediterranean", un apasionado Profesor de Historia Antigua, el Prof. Hundert (Kevin Kline), transmite a sus estudiantes algunas claves para afrontar un apasionado reencuentro con el mundo antiguo y, en particular, con el legado de las civilizaciones clásicas. candidates.title: Una Nueva Versión de la Evolución Humana
candidates.description: Durante los últimos cien años, el desarrollo de la humanidad moderna se explicó principalmente a través de la llamada teoría Fuera de África, afirmando que el desarrollo de humanos y simios ocurrió principalmente en África. Pero en los últimos años, los hallazgos de huesos, mucho más antiguos que los primeros hallazgos de África, han desafiado esa creencia. Restos de 7,2 millones de años de un humano prehistórico, Graecopithecus freybergi, y huellas humanas de 6 millones de años se encontraron en Grecia y se presentaron en 2017. En noviembre de 2019, la paleontóloga Madelaine Böhme reveló al mundo fósiles de un simio antiguo de 11,6 millones de años recién descubierto, encontrado en un pozo de arcilla en el sur de Alemania. Los científicos argumentan que esta nueva especie llamada Danuvius guggenmosi, o "Udo", es un ancestro común de humanos y chimpancés, un eslabón perdido buscado durante décadas por científicos de todo el mundo. Juntos, estos hallazgos fósiles desafían la idea fundamental de la evolución humana.

candidates.title: La Evolución Humana (3 capítulos)
candidates.description: La evolución humana: Descubriendo a nuestros primeros ancestros. Nada nos fascina más que, bueno, nosotros mismos. ¿De dónde venimos? ¿Qué nos hace humanos?  Una explosión de descubrimientos recientes arroja luz sobre estas preguntas, y el especial de tres partes de NOVA, "La evolución humana", examina lo que la investigación científica más reciente revela sobre nuestros parientes homínidos, armando las piezas de nuestro pasado humano y transformando nuestra comprensión de nuestros primeros ancestros. Con entrevistas a científicos de renombre mundial, cada hora se desarrolla con una investigación forense al estilo CSI sobre la vida y la muerte de un ancestro homínido específico. Los programas fueron filmados "en las trincheras" donde se descubrieron los hallazgos a lo largo de África y Europa. Los huesos secos cobran vida con impresionantes animaciones generadas por computadora y prótesis. Los fósiles no solo nos ofrecen pistas sobre cómo lucían los primeros homínidos, sino que, con la ayuda de ingeniosas técnicas de laboratorio, cómo vivían y cómo nos convertimos en los creativos y pensantes humanos de hoy en día.

candidates.title: About the recent Minecraft updates...
candidates.description:
It's been about a year since my partner and I made our video on the 1.19 update, and apparently we just never have the same opinions as the rest of the Minecraft community, so we figured we'd make a video again about the 1.20 update and about the future updates announced in Minecraft Live, and about the state of Minecraft updates in general.
Obviously, our opinions on the 1.20 update leaning more favourable doesn't mean we think anyone else is wrong for disliking the direction Minecraft is heading in, or that we don't have our own criticisms of the updates as well (I strongly disliked the 1.19 update, for example, and I think they need to focus on overall game balancing instead of adding more features that do feel somewhat one-dimensional). Those parts of the video were more aimed at folks making videos like "Minecraft is dying" or who were going out of their way to harass and insult the developers.
With all that said, feel free to disagree with us in the comment section and let me know your thoughts on the situation!

(My mic picking up my keyboard sounds will be fixed in my next video - I tried pretty much everything here to edit them out and it seems this is the best I can do without redoing the video. I apologize for that, I know it's annoying to listen to :/ )

This was originally streamed on Twitch over at https://twitch.tv/PunkWasp and https://twitch.tv/NorseTeaMaiden, if you'd like to watch either of us when we stream you should go follow!

candidates.title: ⚖ JUICIO POR LA MUERTE DE DIEGO MARADONA: SIGUEN LOS CRUCES DENTRO DEL RECINTO
candidates.description:
👉. El juicio por la muerte de Diego Armando Maradona vivió una jornada tensa con un nuevo cruce entre el presidente del tribunal y Francisco Oneto, defensor de Leopoldo Luque. El eje del conflicto fue la exhibición de parte de la historia clínica del exfutbolista, específicamente los registros del bypass gástrico realizados bajo un seudónimo. Mientras las querellas insisten en incorporar esta documentación como prueba clave, las defensas se oponen argumentando irregularidades.

Durante el debate, familiares directos como 'el Chino' Maradona manifestaron su frustración: "Me gustaría que vayan todos presos, porque es una vergüenza lo que pasó", expresó visiblemente afectado. También señaló que este proceso judicial revictimiza a toda la familia y genera un segundo duelo: "Parece que nunca va a haber justicia y lo hacen a propósito".

La audiencia estuvo marcada por gritos e interrupciones entre abogados y jueces. El tribunal decidió deliberar si acepta o no esta prueba, mientras crece el escepticismo sobre una resolución definitiva. Según los presentes, cada escándalo aleja más la posibilidad de conocer la verdad sobre lo ocurrido con Maradona. La expectativa mediática sigue siendo alta tanto a nivel nacional como internacional.

Le sue capacità tecniche lo fecero apprezzare per cui poco più che ventenne (1622-1623) il conte duca di Olivares, suo ammiratore, gli diede l’incarico di pittore di camera.

candidates.title: Diego Maradona - Film Documentario completo in streaming (2019)
candidates.description:
Per la realizzazione di Diego Maradona, Kapadia ha avuto accesso a più di 500 ore di immagini e materiale grafico del giocatore mai visto prima. Prima di tante tappe degne di uno studio dettagliato, ha sudato per rimanere nei 130 minuti di riprese che compongono uno dei più meticolosi ritratti sportivi del cinema recente.

"La tesi sembra semplice, messa su un vassoio dal titolo: il familiare e intimo Diego che affronta il popolare ed egoista Maradona, con successo come un confine recintato dalla droga, dal sesso e dalla mafia", dice Carlos Marañón nella sua recensione del film. "Ma la chiave, oltre a una partita contro l'Inghilterra che spiega tutta una vita, è a Napoli, città che funziona come un personaggio definitivo, un cattivo che cerca vendetta in questa storia di una caduta all'inferno ammortizzata dalla gloria eterna che lo precede.

Napoli è il punto di svolta di una vita e di un'immagine pubblica. E questo è il cuore della storia che Kapadia ha voluto raccontare. "Sono arrivato a Napoli con 85.000 persone che mi hanno accolto, sono partito da solo. Rilassati", dice Maradona nella voce fuori campo del documentario.

Senza fare alcuna pretesa sulla sua fama o qualità, non si può negare la componente di una leggenda, anche per chi è fuori dal mondo del calcio. E questo è ciò a cui Kapadia, esperto ritrattista di altre figure come il pilota di Formula 1 Ayrton Senna (Senna, 2010) o la cantante Amy Winehouse (Amy, 2015), ha voluto mostrare senza enfasi.

Un po' di imbroglio e molto genio". Così qualcuno in questo film riassume la megastar argentina Diego Maradona dopo la sua trionfante performance ai Mondiali di calcio del 1986, e mi sembra giusto. Il film dà la possibilità di valutare come l'imbroglio sia stato un ingrediente minore del genio, non un difetto adiacente.

L'Argentina ha sconfitto la Germania Ovest per 3-2 in finale, con il passaggio di Maradona a Jorge Burruchaga che ha stabilito sia il gol vincente che il suo status di divinità, e quando il documentario di Asif Kapadia riproduce la registrazione audio della telefonata strappalacrime di Diego alla sua anziana madre in Argentina dopo la partita... beh, anche Margaret Thatcher e il governatore delle Falkland Rex Hunt potrebbero aver singhiozzato per il suo saluto emotivo alla donna che ha cresciuto lui e le sue sorelle nei poveri quartieri poveri di Buenos Aires. Diego ha definito la sua mano nei quarti di finale contro l'Inghilterra "la mano di Dio" - ha abitualmente invocato l'Onnipotente per altri successi - e non stava del tutto scherzando. Era l'assistenza divina a favore dei diseredati.

Il film di Kapadia è un racconto avvincente della carriera di Maradona fino alla metà degli anni Novanta, sebbene sia viziato dalla mancanza di materiale nuovo come quello che aveva per il suo precedente film su Amy Winehouse, e anche dalla mancanza di discussioni sui famosi tatuaggi del Che e di Fidel di Maradona e dal suo dichiarato sostegno alla politica socialista.

Come il documentario di Kapadia su Ayrton Senna, anche questo è in termini visivi composto quasi interamente da riprese televisive esistenti, scelte e modellate con intelligenza. Kapadia utilizza i commenti di vari osservatori per aggiungere un contesto, tra cui qualche reminiscenza dell'attuale Maradona, anche se non è del tutto chiaro se si tratta di materiale nuovo.

Nel corso del film, si diventa esperti nel cogliere il lampo di panico o di risentimento agli occhi di Maradona. Imbibirsi di oltre due ore di smalto televisivo e linee di scansione sullo schermo del cinema induce una sorta di isteria, soprattutto quando si tratta di uno spettacolo di tale passione incessante, euforia incessante, catastrofe incessante, isteria di massa per le strade di Buenos Aires e Napoli. Obiettivi, locali notturni, gol, adulazione, gol, gangster, keepy-uppy, fidanzate, gravidanze, negazioni di gravidanza, cocaina, aumento di peso, volubilità della stampa, disperazione - è come la sequenza del titolo di Match of the Day di 130 minuti creata da Sofocle.

Vediamo la sua fanciullezza nella baraccopoli di Villa Fiorito, il suo contratto per Argentinos Juniors all'età di 15 anni, quando ha trasferito tutta la sua famiglia nell'appartamento che gli era stato dato e ne è diventato il capofamiglia. Vediamo la sua disastrosa carriera a Barcellona nei primi anni '80, un paio di stagioni di performance travolgenti, infortuni e combattimenti - e poi il trasferimento a Napoli, dove i suoi sbalorditivi successi lo hanno reso un eroe e un santo vivente, e un compagno di viaggio "made guy" per i mafiosi camorristi. La città che era stata abitualmente derisa dai club e dalle città più prospere del nord - con il brutto canto delle "lavatevi" - divenne la campionessa nazionale. Forse aveva bisogno di stare con gli sfavoriti del Napoli - non con l'elegante Barcellona - per far esplodere la sua sfida.

Fino a quando non ho visto questo, non avevo apprezzato il conflitto di lealtà puramente agonizzante e persino tragico che finalmente è emerso quando l'Argentina ha dovuto giocare l'Italia nello stadio di Napoli ai Mondiali del 1990. Diego ha commesso il grave errore di dire che i napoletani dovevano sostenere l'Argentina contro l'Italia, apparentemente insistendo su quella dolorosa divisione nord-sud che aveva fatto tanto per aiutare il Napoli a superare. E quando l'Argentina ha vinto, è stato troppo: L'adulazione di Napoli per Diego umiliava la città. Tutti i loro successi si rivelarono brutalmente essere solo lui - e ora aveva commesso un tabù imperdonabile. Da lì in poi la situazione è peggiorata, le sue dipendenze da cocaina sono peggiorate e le sue conoscenze tra la mafia napoletana e l'establishment giuridico non hanno più avuto voglia di proteggerlo.

La vista di Maradona è affascinante. È bello vedere il suo giro di velocità mozzafiato, quel centro di gravità così basso che era come un bombardiere stealth che sfrecciava impercettibilmente lungo appena un metro sopra il tappeto erboso.

candidates.title: Christopher H. Lean, "Against Ecological Neoliberalism"
candidates.description:
Speaker | Conférencier : Christopher H. Lean, University of Sydney
Organization | Organisateur : GRÉEA
Date of the event | Date de l’évènement : 08.12.2020
https://greea.ca

Also available on | Également disponible sur Soundcloud: https://soundcloud.com/greea/christopher-h-lean-against-ecological-neoliberalism


Abstract
Philosophers previously have explored the connection between population ecology and economics through the population models they share. There has been, however, a more recent exchange between political and normative strands of economics and conservation ecology, one that focuses not just on population models but the justifications for intervening in nature’s economy. This is the emergence of what I am referring to as ecological neoliberalism through a union of political convenience between those sceptical of invasive species control and the supporters of globalised free-market ideology (including authors from The Economist). Ecological neoliberalism is the position that there should be open biotic borders, and we should not control the free movement of species. When species can move and interact with new ecological systems, they create novel ecosystems. These novel arrangements create experimental markets in nature’s economy, providing opportunities for the efficient production of goods for humans (ecosystem services). When invasives supersede local populations, it indicates previous biotic systems were inefficient, which is why they were replaced, and therefore it is wrong to protect indigenous ‘losers’ from extinction. Those who act to defend indigenous species are accused of being xenophobic against recent biotic migrants. This paper outlines the disconnect between the economic and political arguments as applied to human economies and nature’s economy.

candidates.title: Storchenblick – Wohnmobil-Idylle mit Storchenpaar Adele & Adebar
candidates.description:
🌿 Entdecke den Wohnmobilstellplatz "Storchenblick" – wo Natur, Ruhe und ein Storchenpaar auf dich warten!

Du suchst einen Ort, an dem die Zeit stillzustehen scheint? Wo du ungestört inmitten grüner Wiesen stehen kannst und dabei Adele & Adebar, das Storchenpaar, bei der Aufzucht ihrer Jungen beobachten darfst? Dann ist der private Wohnmobilstellplatz "Storchenblick" im Landkreis Wesermarsch genau das Richtige für dich!
Marc und Anni haben auf ihrem großzügigen Grundstück einen Stellplatz für ein Wohnmobil eingerichtet! Hier gibt es keine Hektik, keine Menschenmassen – nur Natur, Weite und das Gefühl, angekommen zu sein.
In diesem Video nehmen wir dich mit und du erfährst, warum der Stellplatz perfekt für Wanderungen, Radtouren und entspannte Tage im Grünen ist. Und natürlich zeige ich dir, was den Ort so besonders macht: das Storchenpaar Adele & Adebar, das hier sein Nest hat und dich mit seinem Treiben begeistert.


📍 Für wen ist der Storchenblick ideal?
✔ Naturfans, die Ruhe und Abgeschiedenheit lieben
✔ Wohnmobilreisende, die einen privaten, gut ausgestatteten Stellplatz suchen
✔ Vogelbeobachter, die das Treiben von Adele & Adebar live miterleben möchten
✔ Grillmeister, die Wert auf frische Zutaten und kühle Getränke legen

💬 Was denkst du?

candidates.title: Michael Stapelberg – Nix in 2025: Why I switched!
candidates.description:
Nix Your Bugs is a meetup for people in the Rhein-Neckar region that are interested in Nix (the package manager) or NixOS (the Linux distribution). The meetup begins with talks related to NixOS, and ends with casual networking and exchange between the meetup participants.

[Michael Stapelberg](https://michael.stapelberg.ch/) is the inventor and maintainer of the [i3 window manager](https://i3wm.org/), a former [Debian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Debian) Linux Developer, and creator of the Go appliance platform [gokrazy](https://gokrazy.org/). Having occasionally tried NixOS over the years, Michael finally went all in in 2025 and has published multiple blog posts in the process:

-   [How I like to install NixOS (declaratively)](https://michael.stapelberg.ch/posts/2025-06-01-nixos-installation-declarative/)
-   [Migrating my NAS from CoreOS/Flatcar Linux to NixOS](https://michael.stapelberg.ch/posts/2025-07-13-nixos-nas-network-storage-config/)
-   [Development shells with Nix: four quick examples](https://michael.stapelberg.ch/posts/2025-07-27-dev-shells-with-nix-4-quick-examples/)
-   [Secret Management on NixOS with sops-nix](https://michael.stapelberg.ch/posts/2025-08-24-secret-management-with-sops-nix/)
-   [NixCon 2025 Trip Report 🐝](https://michael.stapelberg.ch/posts/2025-09-21-nixcon-2025-trip-report/)

At our Nix Your Bugs #6 Heidelberg meetup on Friday, 17 October 2026, Michael told us more about why he switched and what he learned.

candidates.title: Sicko - Michael Moore (2007) film documentario completo in streaming  [ITA] (Mangione)
candidates.description:
Michael Moore, il cui film Sicko del 2007 ha esaminato il sistema di assicurazione sanitaria degli Stati Uniti, ha affermato che l'ondata di rabbia nei confronti dell'industria è “giustificata al 1000%”. @salute@diggita.com 

Mangione è stato arrestato con il sospetto di aver ucciso Brian Thompson, l'amministratore delegato di UnitedHealthcare. Alcuni hanno applaudito l'accaduto, che potrebbe essere stato motivato dall'ira verso il sistema sanitario privato degli Stati Uniti.

Moore ha spesso affrontato l'industria sanitaria a scopo di lucro, in particolare nel film Sicko del 2007, e ha scritto una lettera aperta in risposta alle ripetute richieste di commento da parte dei media, in seguito alla notizia che il regista sarebbe stato citato negli scritti di Mangione.

“Dopo l'uccisione dell'amministratore delegato di United HealthCare”, ha scritto Moore, ”la più grande di queste compagnie assicurative miliardarie, c'è stata un'immediata esplosione di rabbia nei confronti dell'industria delle assicurazioni sanitarie. Alcune persone si sono fatte avanti per condannare questa rabbia. Io non sono tra questi.

“La rabbia è giustificata al 1000%. È da tempo che i media se ne occupano. Non è una novità. È sempre stata in ebollizione. E non ho intenzione di smorzarla o di chiedere alla gente di stare zitta. Voglio gettare benzina su questa rabbia”.

Moore ha continuato: “Perché questa rabbia non riguarda l'uccisione di un amministratore delegato. Se tutti coloro che sono arrabbiati fossero pronti a uccidere gli amministratori delegati, questi ultimi sarebbero già morti. Non è questo il motivo della reazione. Si tratta della morte e della miseria di massa - il dolore fisico, l'abuso mentale, il debito medico, i fallimenti di fronte a richieste di risarcimento negate e a cure negate e a franchigie senza fondo che si aggiungono a premi sempre più alti - che questa industria della “sanità” ha imposto al popolo americano per decenni. Senza che nessuno si sia messo sulla loro strada! Solo un governo - due partiti in disfacimento - che ha permesso il furto e, sì, l'omicidio di questa INDUSTRIA.

E ora la stampa mi chiama per chiedermi: “Perché la gente è arrabbiata, Mike? Condanni l'omicidio, Mike?”.

“Sì, condanno l'omicidio, ed è per questo che condanno l'industria della sanità americana, che è rotta, vile, rapace, assetata di sangue, non etica, immorale...”.

“Ma non fraintendetemi. Nessuno deve morire”, ha aggiunto Moore. “Anzi, è proprio questo il punto. Nessuno deve morire, nessuno deve morire perché non ha un'assicurazione sanitaria. Nessuna persona dovrebbe morire perché la sua 'assicurazione sanitaria' le nega l'assistenza sanitaria per guadagnare un dollaro o trentadue miliardi di dollari”.

candidates.description:
Official Music Video for "Billie Jean" by Michael Jackson
Listen to more of your favorites by Michael Jackson: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_listenYD

"Billie Jean" was the first short film made for 'Thriller,' the biggest-selling album of all time. The short film for this No. 1 single, directed by Steve Barron, made history as the first video by a black artist to receive heavy rotation on MTV, and was later ranked by the network as one of the 100 greatest music videos of all time.

Subscribe to the official Michael Jackson YouTube Channel: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/subscribeYD

Watch more Michael Jackson videos: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_listenYC/youtube

Follow Michael Jackson: 
Facebook: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_followFI 
Twitter: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_followTI
Instagram: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_followII 
Website: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_followWI 
Spotify: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_followSI

Written & Composed by Michael Jackson
Produced by Quincy Jones for Quincy Jones Productions
Co-Produced by Michael Jackson for MJJ Productions, Inc.
From the album Thriller, released November 30, 1982
Released as a single January 2, 1983

THE SHORT FILM
Director: Steve Barron
Primary Production Location: Los Angeles, California

Michael Jackson's short film for "Billie Jean" was the first of three short films produced for recordings from Thriller, which continues its reign as the biggest selling album of all time with worldwide sales in excess of 105 million as of June 1, 2016 and in December, 2015 became the first ever album to be awarded triple diamond status by the RIAA for US sales alone. The ""Billie Jean"" single reached No. 1 in 10 countries in the spring of 1983, including seven consecutive weeks atop the Billboard Hot 100 - becoming the second-highest selling single in America that same year.

"Billie Jean" was certified Gold by the Recording Industry Association of America on April 4, 1983, and Platinum on February 4, 1989. The song won two Grammy Awards for Best R&B Song and Best R&B Performance - Male, as well as an American Music Award for Favorite Single - Pop/Rock and was also named the Single of the Year on The Village Voice Pazz & Jop critics' poll in 1983.

The short film featured a paparazzo attempting to photograph Jackson as he danced through an urban landscape. A specially created set featured steps and sidewalk tiles that lit up underneath Michael's feet. It is here that fans first saw some of Michael's best-known dance moves, such as spinning and landing on his toes. Many of Michael's steps and mannerisms in the video would become forever associated with The King of Pop.

When the chorus hit.he sprung into this dance that was unlike anything I'd ever seen, director Steve Barron recounted of Jackson's choreography in the video. "It was just extraordinary, instinctive. He pulled it all together and turned it into what we saw.The camera literally steamed up, the eyepiece steamed up, because of my heat from what I was seeing." Barron also recalled the crew breaking into spontaneous applause after Michael finished dancing.

The "Billie Jean" short film made history as the first video by a black artist to be played in heavy rotation on MTV, then in its second year. In 1992, the short film was inducted into the Music Video Producers Hall of Fame. MTV ranked "Billie Jean" as the 35th greatest music video of all time in 1999, one of three entries of Jackson's on the chart alongside "Thriller" and "Beat It."

candidates.title: La Revolucion De Mayo(1909)
candidates.description: La Revolución de Mayo   es una película de   Argentina   sin sonido y en blanco y negro, dirigida por   Mario Gallo   sobre su propio guion que se estrenó el 22 de mayo de 1909 en el teatro Ateneo de la esquina de Corrientes y Maipú y que tuvo como protagonistas. a actores profesionales entre los que se encontraba   Eliseo Gutiérrez . La película se refiere a los acontecimientos sucedidos en   Buenos Aires   en mayo de 1810 conocidos como la   Revolución de Mayo , si bien contiene fallas e inexactitudes como la presencia de   San Martín , una licencia artística del director o la visión en el extremo derecho del cuadro de la persona que sostiene el telón. (Wikipedia) Sinopsis Dirigido por Mario Gallo, está considerado la primera película de ficción argentina realizada con actores profesionales. Representa los acontecimientos de la Revolución de Mayo de 1810, cuyo centenario estaba por cumplirse. La película fue restaurada cien años más tarde con motivo del bicentenario. (FILMAFFINIDAD) Produccion  El director Mario Gallo, un italiano que había llegado a la Argentina en 1905, comenzó a filmar en 1909 y realizó la primera película con argumento de Argentina si bien las opiniones de los estudiosos no son coincidentes en cuanto a su orden temporal. La versión tradicional de  Pablo C. Ducros Hicken   investigador e historiador especializado en cine, la prioridad fue de   El fusilamiento de Dorrego   estrenado el 24 de mayo de 1908. Otros investigadores fechan su rodaje dos años después, lo que significaría que la primera película sería   La Revolución de Mayo   de 1909 Valoracion Algunos estudiosos ven en la obra fílmica de Gallo la influencia de la corriente del Film d'Árt, que desde 1908 intentaba en Francia la primera aproximación al cine como arte, para alejarlo del mero espectáculo de feria, y que tuvo su primera expresión en  El asesinato del Duque de Guisa , filme que tuvo además la particularidad de ser el primero en contar con música original, expresamente solicitada por su director el francés André Calmettes , compuesta por el septuagenario Camille Saint-Saëns para ser ejecutada en vivo durante la proyección.       En La Revolución de Mayo se puede apreciar que su lenguaje está emparentado con el del cine francés de su tiempo: la acción es eminentemente teatral, los decorados pintados en telones (el Cabildo flamea al soplar el viento), la cámara toma el lugar de un espectador y la narrativa queda a carga de las placas con leyendas, funcionando la imagen a la manera de la ilustración de un texto.     Restauracion del filme Fotograma restaurado de La revolución de mayo   Originalmente la copia conservada por la Cinemateca Argentina estaba rodada en soporte nitrato de 35 mm, y por ende altamente inflamable y fue transferida en 1955 a un soporte 16 mm. En la empresa Cinecolor Argentina se reparó básicamente la copia para permitir su escaneado, que luego fue restaurado digitalmente por el Equipo de Restauración y Retoque Digital integrado por Milagros Cimadevilla , Juan Ignacio Bousquet Archivado el 17 de agosto de 2021 en Wayback Machine . y María Victoria Mateu, quienes estabilizaron la imagen, arreglaron los cuadros dañados, limpiaron defectos y eliminaron el flickeo. Más adelante se restauraron y rearmaron las placas usando como base los originales para reemplazar las letras dañadas o inexistentes, se dosificó imagen para emparejar las diferencias de luminancia y contrastes de los distintos planos del cortometraje, y se imprimieron 2 negativos, uno para que pueda ser proyectado en una sala comercial y otro que respeta el formato original de captura, esto quiere decir 35mm con la imagen en el total de la película, de perforación a perforación, en formato 1.37:1 así respetando el nitrato original capturado por Mario Gallo en 1909. .La copia obtenida no presenta los saltos esperables por las huellas del tiempo ni la falta de estabilidad debida a diversos factores: ser rodada a una velocidad inferior de cuadros por segundo y, principalmente, a manivela. En el año 2016 con motivo del Bicentenario de la Independencia se realizó una segunda restauración a cargo de la empresa Gotika a pedido del Instituto Nacional de Cine y Artes Audiovisuales. Se realiza una nueva corrección de color, estabilización, eliminación de rayas y manchas partiendo del negativo escaneado.           Reparto Eliseo Gutiérrez César Fiaschi

candidates.title: Revolución de Mayo de 1810
candidates.description: Este es el sencillo y sentído homenaje que le dejamos a nuestros hombres de Mayo, y además queremos agregar algo importante: Últimamente el confort que las personas eligen, que es refugiarse en la ignorancia y dejar que los poderes imperantes piensen por ellos, formando sus propias "opiniones" en base a lo que oyen de los pseudo-historiadores (como Felipe Pigna) o políticos mayoritariamente progresistas, izquierdistas o liberales, ha hecho que se interprete o reinterprete a Mayo de 1810 de manera equivocada...otra vez de manera equivocada. Pero cuidado, aunque en mucha menor medida, también dentro de ciertos sectores por lo menos autoproclamados "nacionalistas" también se malinterpreta la fecha, sus hechos y sus consecuencias. Por solo citar ejemplos tomando la figura de Mariano Moreno... - Tenemos tanto a liberales como a izquierdistas reivindicando a Moreno...¿curioso no?...los anti-estado (pero que estatizan las deudas) coinciden con los impulsores de un estado interminable en reivindicar la figura o el legado de Moreno...¿será porque no son tan distintos entre si como pretenden mostrarse? Recordemos que antes de esta "ola libertaria" el liberalismo estaba estrechamente relacionado con la izquierda...y tanto el liberalismo progresista como el liberalismo capitalista se desprenden de la Revolución Francesa, aún cuando los segundos suelen ser críticos de esta...una cosa de locos... - Luego tenemos a ciertos nacionalistas, casi exclusivamente de la línea Caponnettiana (conste que valoramos la calidad de escritor de Antonio Caponnetto y su lucha de décadas por reivindicar sanamente la figura de nuestro Restaurador, además de luchar contra las tretas democráticas y zurdoides, defendiendo el Catolicismo de los embates de esos sectores, pero en ciertas cuestiones, simplemente es imposible acompañarle) que critican la Revolución de Mayo olvidándose del Saavedrismo, que puso la semilla al Federalismo, y de que Rosas estableció la celebración de esta fecha al igual que el 9 de Julio, dándoles idéntica importancia y valor. Nosotros queremos diferenciarnos total y absolutamente de los primeros y considerablemente de los segundos: MAYO DE 1810 ES FECHA PATRIA, SAGRADA E INDISCUTIBLE. Tomamos partido por el Saavedrismo como tomaron Rosas y Candioti, y criticamos al Morenismo más que al propio Moreno, al que le hacemos responsable por el fusilamiento de Liniers (héroe del Plata) aunque no negamos que una cosa es estudiar la historia y otra haber vivido los hechos...también es fácil criticar decisiones cuando no fue uno quien las tomó. Moreno en líneas generales no es reivindicable, ni es un prócer...pero tampoco es una figura del todo negativa, aportó cosas importantes, y si de algo más es responsable es de haber dado lugar a una seguidilla de políticos inmorales y despreciables que se agarraron de su figura como tiempo después otros se han agarrado de otras figuras para justificar sus actos sin que estas representasen a los mismos precisamente. Mentira es también que Belgrano fuese "morenista", definitivamente no. Tampoco anti-morenista, ni mucho menos anti-Saavedrista...Belgrano fue el espíritu central de la gesta de Mayo...fue el equilibrio de pensamientos y de fuerzas. Otro de los cientos de laureles que le corresponden al Padre Patrio. candidates.title: La Fiesta De Todos (1978)
candidates.description: La fiesta de todos  es una  película argentina   documental - de comedia  de 1979 dirigida por  Sergio Renán , en torno a la  Copa Mundial de Fútbol de 1978 . Fue escrita por Renán,  Hugo Sofovich  y  Mario Sabato , este último bajo el seudónimo de "Adrián Quiroga". Los  sketches  de comedia del filme son protagonizados por un numeroso grupo de reconocidos actores argentinos y figuras de la cultura. Fue estrenada el 24 de mayo de ese año. El film es una reconstrucción mayormente documental de la victoria argentina en la Copa Mundial realizada en ese país, intercalada con distintos episodios ficticios que suceden durante la misma época. La película ha sido criticada como un intento de mostrar a un pueblo unido disfrutando de una "fiesta de todos", en momentos en que el país era gobernado por la violenta última  dictadura cívico-militar (1976-1983) , 1 ​ la cual había impuesto un régimen de  terrorismo de Estado a nivel nacional . 1 ​ Desde su estreno,  La fiesta de todos  es considerado por muchos críticos de cine como un film de propaganda y apoyo al régimen militar vigente por entonces, ya que este aborda el tema de la preparación y el desarrollo del Mundial de 1978 con una visión optimista y festiva, haciendo apología de un evento que la dictadura había desarrollado para funcionar como una  cortina de humo  que ocultara el  genocidio  que llevaba a cabo el  estado . 1 ​ (Wikipedia) Sinopsis El film es una reconstrucción mayormente documental de la victoria argentina en la  Copa Mundial de Fútbol de 1978 , realizada en ese país, intercalada con distintos episodios ficticios que suceden durante la misma época. candidates.title: AV-1880 [Mundial FIFA Argentina ’78: Ceremonia de apertura] (parte I)
candidates.description: Acto de apertura de la Copa Mundial FIFA Argentina 1978 en el estadio Monumental de Núñez. Tras la placa con el logo de la competencia, se emite un clip promocional sobre la noche de Buenos Aires, que comienza y finaliza con el obelisco, y que incluye imágenes de la comedia musical Chicago, de Edmundo Rivero, del Viejo Almacén y de un típico bar porteño, además de jóvenes bailando en una boite. Seguidamente, la transmisión en vivo de la ceremonia comienza con una suelta de palomas y globos, saludada por salvas. Una banda, integrada por músicos de las tres Fuerzas Armadas, tocan alternativamente marchas militares patrias y la Marcha del Mundial. Una coreografía, en la que participan cientos de jóvenes del Instituto Nacional de Educación Física da forma a diversas leyendas que ocupan la totalidad del campo de juego. Otros jóvenes gimnastas representan a los dieciséis países participantes en el torneo. Aparecen en orden alfabético con un abanderado cuya escolta es una pareja ataviada con los trajes folklóricos de cada país. Recorren la pista de atletismo y luego los abanderados se incorporan a las diversas figuras que forman en el césped los otros gimnastas, cuya culminación es un sol de dieciséis rayos (uno por cada país participante) y el escudo del Mundial. Tras la interpretación del Himno Nacional argentino, se suceden los discursos de Alfredo Francisco Cantilo (presidente de la AFA), João Havelange (presidente de la FIFA) y del presidente de facto Jorge Rafael Videla, que da oficialmente inaugurado el certamen. candidates.title: Creedence Clearwater Revival - Bad Moon Rising (1969) HD
candidates.description: Creedence Clearwater Revival , often referred to as simply  Creedence  or  CCR , was an American  rock  band active in the late 1960s and early 1970s. The band consisted of lead vocalist, lead guitarist, and primary songwriter  John Fogerty , his brother rhythm guitarist  Tom Fogerty , bassist  Stu Cook  and drummer  Doug Clifford . Their musical style encompassed the  roots rock ,   swamp rock , and  blues rock   genres. Despite their  San Francisco Bay Area  origins, they played in a  Southern rock  style, with lyrics about  bayous , catfish, the  Mississippi River , and other popular elements of Southern United States iconography, as well as political and socially-conscious lyrics about topics including the  Vietnam War . The band performed at 1969's famed  Woodstock Festival . After four years of chart-topping success, the group disbanded acrimoniously in late 1972. Tom Fogerty had officially left the previous year, and his brother John was at odds with the remaining members over matters of business and artistic control, all of which resulted in subsequent lawsuits between the former bandmates. Fogerty's ongoing disagreements with  Saul Zaentz , owner of their label  Fantasy Records , created further protracted court battles. As a result, John Fogerty refused to perform with the two other surviving former members at CCR's 1993 induction into the  Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

candidates.title: Colección Pardo: Olimpiadas 68 Stock Shots (V.C. 1256), 1968
candidates.description: Coll HP 1256 1968???? Olimpiadas 68 Stock Shots Umatic.  [00:00 - 00:55] Se ve un partido de lo que parece ser entre dos equipos de divisiones inferiores. Uno de ellos parece ser Toluca y otro Necaxa.  [00:55 - 03:44] Cortinilla que dice: Imevisión Informa. Se ven varias tomas de partidos de fútbol, que se llevan a cabo en diversos estadios. Se ve un partido entre Monarcas y Toluca. De nueva cuenta se ve un partido entre Toluca y Monterrey. Luego un partido entre Pumas vs San Luis, que se lleva a cabo en el Estadio Olímpico. Sigue un partido entre Toluca y Monarcas.  [03:44 - 04:46] Entrevista a un hombre en su oficina de la cual no es posible enterarse toda vez que el audio de la cinta corresponde a un resumen deportivo en el que se narra lo sucedido en el tenis y en la tauromaquia. [04:46 - 08:09] Con una cortinilla de Imevisión se abre el segmento en el que se ve una pelea de boxeo. Uno de los boxeadores al parecer se trata de Julio Cesar Chávez. Luego se ve un partido de béisbol de la liga mexicana. Acto seguido se muestra un marcador de un partido de béisbol entre Cleveland y Milwaukee. Luego sigue otras tomas de un partido, ahora en la que participan los Dodgers.  [08:09 - 11:30] Ahora con el arreglo del sonido e imagen, se ve el momento en que Norma Enriqueta Basilio enciende el pebetero olímpico. La narración habla de los juegos olímpicos del Caribe de 1990. Se habla además de la rehabilitación a la que se ha sometido el Estadio Olímpico Universitario de la UNAM. Acto seguido se hace una entrevista a un funcionario de la universidad. Sigue una serie de tomas de la inauguración de los juegos olímpicos de 1968, así como imágenes de aquel evento y sus momentos más significativos.  [11:30 - 14:25] El presidente de México Carlos Salinas de Gortari escucha a una mujer indígena que habla en su idioma materno. Luego se ve a Salinas de Gortari en un templete ofreciendo un discurso, en el que destaca que se han escuchado las demandas. Siguen fragmentos de otros discursos del político, ya sea giras o en la Cámara de Diputados. Luego se ve un auditorio lleno donde se lleva a cabo un congreso de la Central Campesina Independiente, en este lugar el presidente realiza un discurso. Acto seguido se ve al presidente dialogando con un grupo de campesinos.  [14:25 - 20:15] Resumen de un partido de béisbol en el que participó el equipo de Pittsburgh. Y al finalizar se muestran los resultados de otros equipos de béisbol. Proyecto realizado con el apoyo del Instituto Mexicano de Cinematografía a través del programa de Fomento al Cine (FOCINE)

candidates.title: Documental 'Educación inclusiva. Quererla es crearla'
candidates.description:
VERSIÓN CON SUBTÍTULOS INCRUSTADOS EN ESPAÑOL (2 GB)

SINOPSIS
“Quererla es crearla” es un documental acerca de un derecho, una necesidad, un deseo, un compromiso político y una posibilidad: hacer que en las escuelas todas las personas puedan aprender a vivir juntas. Construir sociedades inclusivas requiere desmontar los prejuicios que tenemos sobre la diversidad y las diferencias, para lo que necesitamos revisar las escuelas en las que parte del alumnado no cabe, es maltratado y segregado, mientras el resto aprende a ver la discriminación como algo correcto y deseable.

La película reflexiona sobre esta realidad a través de diversas historias que se entrecruzan en la defensa del derecho a la educación inclusiva. Arranca con el caso de Rubén Calleja, que fue expulsado de su escuela primaria y obligado a ser escolarizado en un centro de educación especial, algo que su familia se negó a acatar. Tras años de lucha legal, Rubén obtiene el respaldo de Naciones Unidas, con una sentencia pionera en contra del sistema educativo español. La educación inclusiva es un derecho fundamental, que habilita la posibilidad de participar en el mundo.

La historia de Rubén es el hilo conductor de otras luchas, más profundas y complejas que la jurídica, que comparten un grupo de estudiantes y sus familias: las que se refieren a los idearios compartidos socialmente, a la cultura, las políticas y las prácticas escolares, que discriminan fuertemente por capacidad, origen social, género, etnia, salud, orientación sexual, nacionalidad, etc. Pero que también perjudican a quienes no entran en esas categorías, porque nadie puede ajustarse a la normalidad a la que sirven las escuelas. Con el trasfondo de una lucha que ha de ser compartida por toda la población, este grupo de personas muestra la necesidad de salir de sus insoportables situaciones opresivas, a la vez que nos introducen en los sueños cotidianos, sencillos e ilusionantes de cualquier persona, sus acciones para hacerlos realidad, las pequeñas cosas que conforman el día a día… Pero por encima de todo, el film es el testimonio de un movimiento colectivo: la inclusión no es algo lejano e inalcanzable, sino una experiencia real que viven muchas personas hoy, que profundiza en la diversidad y, por tanto, en nuestra naturaleza humana.

candidates.title: La Cancion De Buenos Aires ( 1939)
candidates.description: La modelo de la calle Florida  es una película de  Argentina  en blanco y negro dirigida por  Julio Irigoyen  y producida en 1939 (Wikipedia) Sinopsis Historia de un joven acomodado que intenta seducir con malas artes a una muchacha buena, que sólo quiere vivir dedicada a su madrecita. Pero antes de comenzar a narrar ese tema, un cartel anuncia que Buenos Aires “tiene un aspecto escondido por cuyas vértebras ruedan las perdiciones”, y los siguientes quince minutos registran de manera documental los números vivos de un café. Reparto Laura Nelson Arturo Sánchez Enrique Vico Carré Yaya Palau Aurelia Musto Produccion El filme fue producido por  Buenos Aires Film , una empresa dirigida por Julio Irigoyen que se caracterizaba por producir filmes clase “C” de muy bajo presupuesto y poca calidad artística, que en general eran historias con los personajes característicos de la ciudad: guapos prostitutas, cantores de  tango , jugadores en oscuros cafetines, hipódromos y salones aristocráticos. La mayoría eran películas de gauchos o típicamente porteñas, con tango o con canciones de tierra adentro. Es dificultoso acceder a información sobre esas películas, en primer lugar porque una parte no se estrenó en Buenos Aires sino en las provincias del interior de Argentina y también en otros países de  América Latina , en segundo término porque Irigoyen no conservaba los negativos y en tercer lugar por el escaso interés que tenía por ellas la prensa especializada.

candidates.title: MATRIX ET BOURDIEU - LE MIRACLE DU SOCIAL
candidates.description:
Comment la vie en communauté est-elle rendue possible ? Malgré nos récits personnels, nos points de vue et nos croyances variées, la cohabitation semble impossible sur le papier. Et si c'était là la plus grande leçon des films Matrix ? Dans cette vidéo-essai, j'explore comment Matrix et le sociologue Pierre Bourdieu éclairent ce paradoxe. Bien que leurs approches soient distinctes, ces deux perspectives ont profondément influencé ma vie, et je devais les aborder ensemble, même si cela nécessitera une vidéo longue.

Compléments, sources et crédits : https://tranxen.fr/matrix-et-bourdieu-le-miracle-du-social/

Cette vidéo est la version "Director's Cut" de la trilogie de vidéos que j’ai fait sur Matrix et Pierre Bourdieu. Ce n’est pas une simple mise-bout-à-bouts, j’en ai profité pour modifier beaucoup de petites choses : enlever des passages qui ont mal vieilli, refaire la voix sur d’autres, et rajouter quelques petites choses par-ci par là. Le changement le plus évident est que ce n’est plus le même format d’image, et que j’ai maintenant un montage plus fluide et cohérent entre les 3 parties. On obtient ainsi cette longue vidéo avec environ 10 minutes totalement inédites !

C’est vraiment la version ultime que je vous propose. Si vous n'aviez pas encore vu la trilogie, c'est l'occasion de la voir sous son meilleur jour ! L’écriture ayant débuté en 2019 et le premier tournage en 2021, vous comprenez que ce projet me tenait particulièrement à cœurs. Je tenais à offrir pour ce sujet la meilleure version de ce dont j’étais capable, malgré la masse de travail et les embûches que je pouvais rencontrer. Un jour je vous raconterais cette aventure.

Je compte sur vous pour partager cette vidéo, c’est celle qui le mérite le plus a mes yeux. Elle fait partie d’un cycle de vidéo sur le militantisme, vous pouvez retrouver toutes les vidéos sur le sujet dans cette playlist : https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWR0v8LhS6yCOxRAIzbEfDYgPhXyBLkw5
#Sociologie #MatrixFilms #PierreBourdieu

Time-code :
0:00 Introduction
2:34 PARTIE 1 : Qu’est-ce que la Matrice ?
10:50 Pilule bleu VS pilule rouge
15:08 Le déterminisme social
28:08 La matrice du genre
39:12 PARTIE 2 : Recréer des matrices en croyant s'en sortir
40:32 L’impasse de la pensée "anti-système"

1:10:56 PARTIE 3 : Hacker la matrice pour être enfin libre
1:12:22 Choisir SA voie ?

1:29:40 Ce que Matrix et Bourdieu m’ont appris sur le militantisme
1:35:15 Conclusion

Remerciements à Bleu, Anariposa, Raf, Troost’, Marie, Michael, Pleen, la TeamBourdieu, Aurèle et Marina, Misterfox.

candidates.title: ARANDA SUFRIÓ UNA FRACTURA DE PERONÉ, SERÁ OPERADO Y BOCA LO PERDERÍA HASTA 2027 🔵 🟡
candidates.description:
La peor noticia que podía recibir el mundo Boca se dio en el entrenamiento de esta mañanja en el predio de Ezeiza. Tomás Aranda sufrió una fractura de peroné en su pierna derecha y tras los primeros estudios se determinó que deberá ser operado en los próximos días. Aún sin plazos concretos para su vuelta, creen que su recuperación podría dejarlo afuera de las canchas hasta 2027. 

En una de sus clásicas maniobras, el juvenil hizo un cambio de dirección y el botín le quedó clavado en el césped. Lo que en un principio se vio con optimismo como un esguince, luego se confirmó que se trata nada menos que de una rotura ósea y ya prácticamente lo descartan para lo que resta de la temporada.

Según confirmaron desde el cuerpo médico de Boca, Aranda deberá ser sometido a una intervención quirúrgica en los próximos días. La fractura de peroné se dio en la zona de unión con la tibia y tras la operación, los plazos de recuperación superarían los tres meses, incluso podrían llegar a cinco. Así, lo más probable es que su vuelta se dé para la pretemporada. 

En Boca el impacto fue muy fuerte, ya que se había convertido en la gran figura ofensiva del equipo. Tras ganarse el puesto en el final del ciclo de Claudio Úbeda, con la llegada de Rodolfo Arruabarrena heredó la 10 de Edinson Cavani y enseguida empezó a responder con grandes actuaciones. Titular inamovible, ahora el Vasco deberá definir cómo reemplazar a un jugador de cualidades inéditas en el plantel. 

Para el duelo de este viernes ante Lanús en la Bombonera, por la séptima fecha del Torneo Clausura, el cambio más lógico sería el ingreso de Alan Velasco, quien desde la llegada del nuevo cuerpo técnico ha tenido muy buenas apariciones y venía pidiendo pista. La otra alternativa sería juntar a Leonel Flores con Sebastián Villa y Miguel Merentiel en el ataque. Sin tiempo por la seguidilla de partidos que se avecina, en Boca saben que deberán asimilar el golpe cuanto antes y seguir adelante.
